description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Furystoke Giant.
When Furystoke Giant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Furystoke Giant enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Furystoke Giant.
When Furystoke Giant dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Furystoke Giant enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.
